title: Sena 50S Mesh 2.0
features: Mesh 2.0 digital communication technology for clear audio
Up to 16 riders per group with seamless switching
Built-in GPS tracking and live location sharing
description:
Engineered to seamlessly integrate into modern helmet speaker cavities, the Sena 50S Mesh 2.0 from Sena provides riders with uninterrupted acoustic clarity and group connectivity. Built with IP67 Certified Dustproof & Submersion Resistant (All-Season Waterproof Seal), it boasts an installation rating of 2.5 / 10 (Clamp-mount or 3M VHB base with recessed speaker cavity routing).

The Sena 50S Mesh 2.0 represents an indispensable touring and group-ride upgrade from Sena. Its robust audio tuning and rock-solid weather sealing provide riders with effortless navigation cues and reliable connectivity across arduous highway tours.
